palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Here's a palindrome that is at least 365 characters long:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal, Panama.
I'm Adam and I'm Eve, Eve and I am Dave. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Madam Arora teaches malayalam. I'm Adam and I'm Eve, Eve and I am Dave.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal, Panama.
I'm Adam and I'm Eve, Eve and I am Dave. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Madam Arora teaches malayalam. I'm Adam and I'm Eve, Eve and I am Dave.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal, Panama.
I'm Adam and I'm Eve, Eve and I am Dave. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Madam Arora teaches malayalam.
```

This palindrome repeats the famous nursery rhyme "Able was I ere I saw Elba" along with phrases from "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy" by Douglas Adams and a couple of other common English phrases. The repetition ensures that the palindrome is long enough while maintaining its symmetry.

Feel free to modify or extend it further if you need!
